question.text: A distributor empanelled with a Category III AIF can:

answer.text: Be empanelled only with one AIF
Be empanelled with MORE than one AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.82), a distributor of a Category III AIF may be an individual or an institution and can be empanelled with more than one Category III AIF. The Trap: Single-empanelment or individual-only / institution-only restrictions are not imposed by the workbook. Note: Where multiple empanelments create a material conflict of interest, that conflict should be disclosed to the client.
